exposure: Cesarean delivery for failure to progress
cohort: 210,708 pregnant women without major obstetrical complications who delivered a singleton live infant
finding: Epidural analgesia in labor was associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Epidural analgesia in labor was associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery for both failure to progress and fetal distress, but the association was stronger for failure to progress.
